about.title: About this directory
about.what: This is a list of places that help after violence. It shows where to go, what they provide, and when the details were last checked.
about.not: It is not an emergency service. It does not contact anyone for you.
about.private: Nothing you search or open is sent anywhere. The list is saved on this phone and works without a connection.
about.trust: Every entry shows where its details came from and when they were last checked. Old entries are flagged, not hidden.
about.coverage: Coverage is partial and not exhaustive.
about.poc: This is a proof of concept.
about.exit: The Leave button clears the screen and opens a neutral website. Pressing Escape does the same.
